title: on chain agent
tagline: On-chain AI Agent Platform is combines a sophisticated architecture of AI agents, DeFi mechanics, and cutting-edge Web3 tools to create a fully autonomous fund management platform.
description:
Core Concept
The platform facilitates the deployment, operation, and interaction of AI agents directly on blockchain networks. These agents autonomously perform tasks, utilizing smart contracts to function securely in decentralized environments without dependence on centralized servers. It aims to empower individuals and organizations to integrate AI seamlessly into decentralized applications (dApps).

Key Features
Decentralized AI Execution
AI agents operate on-chain or through verifiable computation layers linked to the blockchain, ensuring transparency, auditability, and reliability.

Programmable AI Agents
Developers can configure autonomous AI agents with customizable logic and models. These agents can handle tasks such as data processing, decision-making, and user engagement within dApp ecosystems.

Seamless Data Integration
AI agents securely access both on-chain data (via oracles) and off-chain sources like APIs or IoT networks, enabling dynamic interactions.

Incentive Structures
Encourages contributors to share AI models, datasets, or computing resources by rewarding them through token-based economic systems.

Cross-Chain Interoperability
Enables AI agents to function across multiple blockchain networks using cross-chain bridges, enhancing flexibility and connectivity.

AI-Driven Decentralized Governance
Enhances decision-making in DAOs by analyzing data and offering strategic recommendations or solutions.

Privacy and Security
Leverages blockchain’s cryptographic safeguards and privacy-preserving techniques, such as zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs), to ensure secure computations.

AI Services and Model Marketplace
A decentralized marketplace where users can deploy, monetize, or acquire AI-powered services, models, and agent functionalities.
how_its_made:
Core Components  

Agent API  
The Agent API serves as the intelligence hub of the platform, integrating AI-driven decision-making with fund management. It utilizes FastAPI for API management, the CDP SDK for handling on-chain agents, and OpenAI's LLM for analyzing both on-chain and off-chain data to provide insights. Swarm is responsible for orchestrating AI agents, while MongoDB stores agent states, transaction history, and user interactions.  

Frontend  
The frontend provides a seamless user experience, allowing users to interact with the fund manager, monitor fund performance, and track transactions. Built with ReactJS, it leverages Viem and Wagmi to simplify Web3 interactions, such as wallet connections, token approvals, and asset management. Tailwind CSS ensures a modern, responsive UI.  

Smart Contracts  
The platform uses the ERC-4626 tokenized vault standard, enabling standardized interactions with the fund. This allows users to deposit assets, earn returns, and withdraw funds efficiently. Integrated with the CDP SDK, the vault autonomously manages assets through the AI agent.  

Blockchain Deployment
The platform is deployed on the Base Chain, chosen for its high scalability, low transaction fees, and strong security. This ensures efficient on-chain fund management and AI-driven interactions.
